g.text: DNA EXTRACTION (4.3.1): CHOOSE THE METHOD BY SEQUENCING APPROACH AND READ LENGTH
V. cholerae is Gram-negative: chemical lysis works; bead beating, which fragments DNA, is not needed
Fragments typically 20–50 kb: ample for Illumina
Also adequate for ONT in most public health work
Avoids column shearing; fragments well over 50 kb
Only needed for repetitive regions or reference-quality

Fast and simple, less input DNA
Fine for most public health uses
R10.4.1 flow cells; R9.4.1 is no longer recommended (higher error)
Can give complete, circularised assemblies of both chromosomes
Validate before ONT defines outbreak clusters: V. cholerae evidence is
limited; elsewhere MLST matched Illumina but cgMLST varied.
